name: Sikky Manufacturing
old_description: Founded in 2008, Sikky Manufacturing has worked relentlessly to become a world leader in the LS swap market.
about:
Sikky Manufacturing was founded in 2008 in Rosedale, Maryland. The company began with a focus on the LS engine swap market, developing precision-engineered components for automotive enthusiasts and builders.

The company produces a range of LS swap parts including motor mounts, complete swap kits, shifters, front drive kits, headers, oil pans, air conditioning kits, and transmission adapters. It also offers private label manufacturing services, providing design, testing, and production for other businesses. Core processes include CNC machining of 6061 billet aluminum and stainless steel fabrication, with all products assembled and finished in-house.

Sikky serves the automotive aftermarket, specifically the LS engine swap segment, selling directly to enthusiasts and professional builders through its catalog. It also targets business owners seeking domestic contract manufacturing for custom parts, offering end-to-end private label services from concept to finished product.

The company emphasizes a no-compromise quality standard, stating that every product is built with precision, passion, and an unwavering commitment to perfection. It highlights domestic production as a core value, noting that manufacturing locally supports American jobs and upholds craftsmanship. Its motor mounts are described as industry-leading for precise fitment and performance.
